items.title: 17.12 RLC series circuit se AC (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of AC through an RLC series circuit (PDF 102-105).

blocks.text: Badalne wali frequency ke AC source se jura RLC series circuit lein (Fig 17.11 a). Is ke impedance diagram (Fig 17.11 b) mein inductive reactance XL = wL aur capacitive reactance XC = 1/(wC) mukhalif simton mein hain. Is liye impedance Z = (R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) ka square root (17.24) = (R^2 + (wL - 1/(wC))^2) ka square root (17.25).

blocks.alt: (a) AC source ke saath series mein R, L aur C, current I. Saath teen chhote graph: R ke liye Vo aur Io aik saath; L ke liye Vo chauthai chakkar aage; C ke liye Vo chauthai chakkar peeche. Ghoomta phasor daira XL ko +90 darje aur XC ko -90 darje par, 180 darje ke farq se dikhata. (b) Impedance tikon ABC: AB par R, BC par XL - XC, AC par Z, zawiya theta.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.11 (a), (b): (a) RLC series circuit aur us ka phasor diagram; (b) RLC series circuit ka impedance vector diagram (kitab ki Figure 17.11 (a), (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: XL aur XC aik doosre ke ulat simt mein hain (aik +90 darje, doosri -90 darje), is liye un ka farq XL - XC hi R ke saath milta hai: Z = (R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) ka square root. Agar XL bari ho to circuit RL jaisa, XC bari ho to RC jaisa.

Zyada frequency par XL = wL, XC = 1/(wC) se kaheen zyada hai, is liye inductance ghalib aur circuit RL series ki tarah bartao karta hai. Kam frequency par XC ghalib aur yeh RC series ki tarah bartao karta hai. Darmiyan aik frequency wr hai jis par XL = XC: barabar aur mukhalif reactances aik doosre ko khatam karti hain, aur circuit sirf resistance wale circuit ki tarah bartao karta hai (Fig 17.11 c). Yeh halat resonance kehlati hai. wr L = 1/(wr C) se: wr^2 = 1/(LC), wr = 1/(LC) ka square root, aur kyunke wr = 2 pi fr, resonant frequency fr = 1/(2 pi x (LC) ka square root) (17.26).

blocks.alt: (c) Aik ufqi teer R: XL = XC par sirf resistance bachti hai. (d) Current I aur frequency f: resonance frequency fr par tez chotti, chotti par dashed lakeer, mehwar se chotti tak dohra teer aur dono taraf ufqi teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.11 (c), (d): (c) XL = XC par RLC series circuit sirf resistance ki tarah; (d) XL = XC par resonance (kitab ki Figure 17.11 (c), (d) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: RLC series circuit ki ahem khasiyatein

items: Impedance aur resonance: resonance par impedance kam se kam, Z = R, aur fr = 1/(2 pi x (LC) ka square root).
Current: resonance par impedance kam se kam hone ki wajah se current zyada se zyada hai (Fig 17.11 d).
Phase zawiya: resonance par sifar; voltage aur current in phase aur power factor 1.

Damping: resistor current ke jhoolne ko damp karta hai; zyada resistance zyada damping. Gari ka suspension mechanical misal hai: shock absorber resistance ki tarah tawanai zaya karta, aur kamiyat aur spring resonant frequency tay karte hain (Fig 17.11 e, tasveer).

Tuning aur filtering: resonance par RLC series circuits radio receivers tune karne aur doosre rabte ke aalaat mein, aur band-pass filters ke taur par use hote hain jo chuni hui frequencies guzar kar baqi kamzor karte hain.
Voltage ka barhna: resonance par inductor aur capacitor par alag alag voltage lagaye gaye voltage se kaheen zyada ho sakta hai.
Taqat: haqeeqi taqat P = VI cos(theta) (17.27), sab se zyada jab theta = 0, yani resonance par ya khalis resistance ke liye.

blocks.title: Apparent power
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke apparent power 'VI cos(theta) ke barabar hai'. Apparent power hasil-e-zarb VI (volt-ampere mein) hai; haqeeqi taqat VI cos(theta) hai, aur power factor cos(theta) in ka tanasub hai.

LCR circuit mein inductor, capacitor aur resistor par voltages VL = 20 V, VC = 11 V aur VR = 12 V hain. Nateeja voltage aur current ka phase farq, aur source ka rms voltage maloom karein. Hal: tan(theta) = (VL - VC)/VR = (20 V - 11 V)/12 V = 0.75, is liye theta = tan^-1(0.75) = 36.9 darje. Vrms = [VR^2 + (VL - VC)^2] ka square root = [(12 V)^2 + (9 V)^2] ka square root = 225 V^2 ka square root = 15 V.

L = 10 mH aur C = 1.0 uF wale series circuit ki resonant frequency maloom karein. Hal: fr = 1/(2 pi x (LC) ka square root) = 1/(2 x 3.14 x (10 x 10^-3 x 1.0 x 10^-6) ka square root) = 1/(2 x 3.14 x 1.0 x 10^-4) = 1.59 x 10^3 Hz, taqreeban 1.6 kHz.

blocks.prompt: Kitab ceiling fan ki wiring dikhati hai: switch, running winding, capacitor ke saath series mein starting winding, aur rotor. Yeh kis qism ka AC circuit hai?
blocks.explanation: Capacitor-start (split-phase) motor circuit: series capacitor ke saath starting winding RLC jaisi shaakh banati hai jis ka current running winding ke current se phase mein khiska hai, is liye dono windings mil kar ghoomta magnetic field banati hain.

items: XL = XC par resonance: fr = 1/(2 pi sqrt(LC)); Z = R, current zyada se zyada, power factor 1.
